risks.note: Changes in regulatory requirements, inspections and delays in product approvals may affect product launches and exports. Mitigation cited: continuous compliance with EU-GMP and other international quality standards, regular audits and strengthening of quality systems.

Intense competition from domestic and global pharmaceutical companies may result in pricing pressure and margin compression. Mitigation cited: focus on complex formulations, specialty products, biologics, product differentiation and operational efficiency.

Fluctuations in raw material prices and disruptions in global supply chains may increase manufacturing costs and affect production schedules. Mitigation cited: diversified supplier base, strategic procurement and inventory management.
risks.risk: Raw material and supply chain risk

risks.note: Volatility in foreign exchange rates may impact export revenues and profitability — structurally significant for an export-led model. Mitigation cited: natural hedging through diversified export markets and prudent treasury management.

Manufacturing interruptions, equipment failures or quality issues may affect business continuity. Mitigation cited: preventive maintenance, process automation, robust quality control systems and business continuity planning.

Delays in product development, bio-equivalence studies or regulatory approvals may postpone commercialisation. Mitigation cited: continuous investment in R&D, project monitoring and regulatory planning.
Increasing digitalisation exposes the Company to cyber threats and data security risks. Mitigation cited: IT security controls, data protection measures and periodic cybersecurity assessments.

The Directors' Report and MD&A flag supply chain disruptions and geopolitical uncertainties as a threat; the Company also lists intellectual property risks, financial and liquidity risks and environmental, health and safety risks within its risk framework. The Board states that in its assessment there are no risks which may threaten the existence of the Company.
